name: row-barbell-bent-over
title: Row: Barbell (Bent-Over)
primer: This exercise focuses on the middle back.
steps: Place your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend over the bar so your back is flat and parallel to the floor.
Grasp the bar a bit wider than shoulder width apart with an overhand grip.
Hold the bar at arm's length. This is the starting position.
Slowly raise the bar to the lower part of your chest.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your head up and your back straight while performing this exercise.
